Name: SpaceCore Android for JunimoGate
Author: aplKd
Description:
SpaceCore 的 JunimoGate Android 兼容移植版，为《星露谷物语》Android 版提供自定义技能、序列化、锻造配方及其他 SpaceCore 框架功能。

  本项目基于 spacechase0 的原版 SpaceCore 和 NRTnarathip 的 Android 分支开发，保留 spacechase0.SpaceCore 模组 ID，以兼容依赖 SpaceCore 的模组。

  需要 JunimoGate、Stardew Valley 1.6.15 或更高版本，以及 SMAPI API 4.3 或更高版本。本项目不是官方桌面版 SpaceCore。


  An Android-compatible port of SpaceCore for JunimoGate. It provides custom skills, serialization, forge recipes, and other SpaceCore framework features for Stardew Valley on Android.

  This port is based on the original SpaceCore project by spacechase0 and the Android fork by NRTnarathip. It retains the spacechase0.SpaceCore mod ID for compatibility with mods that depend on SpaceCore.

  Requires JunimoGate, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later, and SMAPI API 4.3 or later. This is not the official desktop release of SpaceCore.

Manifest.Name: SpaceCore Android for JunimoGate
Manifest.Description: Android source port of the SpaceCore framework mod for JunimoGate.
